title: Idea Lineage
description: IDEATE-stage deep-ideation artifact. Output of the idea-lineage-tracker. The provenance LEDGER for every candidate idea: the chain of typed artifacts it descended through (problem_abstraction -> mechanism_graph -> mechanism_mapping(s) -> gap(s) -> hypothesis -> contradiction(s) -> experiment_sketch) plus its evolutionary parents and its PIPELINE disposition. This makes the system's depth accumulable and auditable across runs instead of vanishing into prose. HARD governance (mirrors idea_backlog): there is NO selected / chosen / bet / winner field — `disposition` records the MECHANICAL fate of an idea inside the pipeline (still a candidate, cut for evidenced prior art, merged as a duplicate, or an evolved descendant), never a recommendation. The director still bets via the /idea-bet human gate. Anti-slop: every lineage carries a non-empty evidence_ref and refs that look real (digit-guarded).

lineages.description: One lineage record per candidate idea (originals + evolved). minItems:1.

idea_id.description: The idea this lineage traces, e.g. IDEA-1 / EV-1. Non-blank.

problem_ref.description: Optional: the problem_abstraction.problem_id at the root of this idea's chain. Real-ref guard (digit).

mechanism_graph_ref.description: Optional: the mechanism_graph.graph_id this idea's mechanism reasoning came from.

mechanism_mapping_refs.description: Optional: mechanism_mapping.mapping_id(s) (cross-domain analogies) feeding this idea.

gap_refs.description: Optional: the gap_id(s) this idea addresses.

hypothesis_ref.description: Optional: the hypothesis_id this idea realizes. Real-ref guard (digit).

contradiction_refs.description: Optional: contradiction conflict_id(s) this idea had to account for.

experiment_sketch_ref.description: Optional: the experiment_sketch.sketch_id that makes this idea testable.

parent_ids.description: Evolutionary provenance: the idea_id(s) this one was mutated/recombined from (empty for an original).

disposition.description: MECHANICAL pipeline fate (never a bet): candidate = still on the /idea-bet menu; cut_prior_art = removed by the novelty-collision gate (evidenced prior art); merged_duplicate = folded into another idea by dedup; evolved = a descendant produced by the idea-evolver.

evidence_ref.description: Anti-slop: at least one non-blank pointer backing this lineage record (an upstream id or [[slug]]).

notes.description: Optional: e.g. why an idea was cut/merged, or a drift note.
